name: SRT → Multi RTMP
summary: Receive an SRT MPEG-TS stream and republish to multiple RTMP endpoints in parallel. Drive the destination list from an iterator table — pick the streaming service per row from a kv preset library.
description: Listens for an SRT MPEG-TS input, demuxes video + audio, fans out through a tee into a loop group containing one prototype FLV branch (queue → flvmux → queue → rtmp2sink). The group iterates over a table of RTMP targets; each row picks a service (kv-resolved endpoint URL) plus a stream key, and the parameter template `${service}${key}` builds the final URL.

elements.name: srtsrc
elements.rationale: SRT MPEG-TS input. May need gst-plugins-bad on some distros.

elements.name: rtmp2sink
elements.rationale: Modern RTMP sink. Pre-1.18 builds may only ship rtmpsink.

variables.label: SRT Port
variables.description: TCP port the SRT listener binds on (0.0.0.0). The pipeline includes a Concat transform that assembles the full srt:// URI from this port.
